# Preprocessing decisions (generated by src/harmonise.py)

Configuration: `config/pipeline.toml`, grid 5 deg, QC night SZA > 100 deg and VZA <= 60 deg.

| # | Decision | Why | Effect on resolution / information |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CLARA OLR used as stored, W m-2 positive upward; ERA5 OLR = -ttr/3600 per hourly accumulation (monthly by hour of day) | ERA5 ttr is a J m-2 accumulation, negative upward; validated: the 24 h mean of the hourly product equals the monthly product to 0.0071 W m-2 | none |
| 2 | Physical-unit harmonisation only; y and ERA5 are standardised inside each CV fold with training rows | prevents leakage of test-fold statistics | none |
| 3 | QC: read_in earth_view & in_range [50 (raised {2024: 75.0, 2025: 90.0}), 400] W m-2, footprint SZA > 100 deg, VZA <= 60 deg | CLARA measures OLR on the night side only; daylit footprints read tens of W m-2 higher; VZA > 60 deg shows strong limb darkening (results/eda/physics_*.png) | keeps 225,460 of 470,515 usable samples (48%) |
| 4 | Overpasses: consecutive QC'd samples separated by <= 20 min belong to one overpass; n_overpasses per cell-month enters the noise model | samples along one track are strongly correlated (lag-1 r ~ 0.9), so the sampling error scales with overpasses, not samples | none |
| 5 | Monthly resolution, 5 deg cells (grid.res_deg; user and supervisor choice), model time = middle of the month | ERA5 night-time product is monthly; a cell-month mean is the CLARA estimand | CLARA values are only binned by footprint centre, never interpolated or copied to another cell. 5 deg is coarser than ERA5 and no finer than CLARA's effective footprint. "day" is not used as a predictor |
| 6 | ERA5 night-time mean: hourly monthly means weighted by the fraction of the month's days on which each hour is night (SZA > 100 deg at the 1 deg cell centre); polar-day cells (no night hour in the month) use the mean of the 3 darkest hours instead and are flagged night_fallback | matches what CLARA can observe; a 24 h mean mixes in daytime OLR; the fallback gives the prediction grid every lat-lon cell (user requirement) | the fallback value is a different quantity (darkest hours of a sunlit month) and CLARA never observes those cells: predictions there are extrapolation and are hatched on maps |
| 7 | ERA5 0.25 deg -> 1 deg trapezoid area means -> 5 deg area means (cos-lat weights) | conservative area averaging, not point interpolation | ERA5 effective resolution degraded to the model grid; no new information |
| 8 | ERA5 spherical-cap smoothing at R in 0, 300, 600, 1000, 1500 km kept as candidate predictors; R is chosen per CV fold on training rows | CLARA sees a wide footprint (unknown FOV); matching effective resolutions without using test data | smoothing uses ERA5 only; it never fills NaN cells |
| 9 | Observation table holds only cell-months with >= 1 QC'd CLARA sample; the prediction grid holds every lat-lon cell of every month and flags clara_observed and night_fallback | genuine missingness is kept explicit; the grid has no gaps | none |
| 10 | post_gap (1 from 2021-09 on, 0 before) enters every model's mean function as beta2 (gp.gap_step); the period labels pre-gap / post-gap are kept for reporting | CLARA - ERA5 changes by ~40 W m-2 across the 2021-09 -> 2022-05 data gap (calibration step, EDA); the user chose a step predictor. The gap months are assigned to the post-gap regime by convention | CLARA never observes the gap months, so predictions there are extrapolation and the step is placed at the start of the gap |
| 11 | CERES EBAF is joined only into the EDA reference table, never into the model inputs | user decision: CERES is an EDA reference | none |
